english_problem: Two circles tangent to line AB at A and B intersect at M and N on the same side of AB, with M closer to AB than N. Triangle NAB is acute and scalene. If AB=10, ON=25*sqrt(2)/6, and MF=3, find the area of triangle EPQ.
